falsification_conditions.condition: S&P 500 closes above 5,600 on any single day within the next 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The 78% pattern match to bottom_2024_aug is broken; the August 2024 bottom saw lower highs for 3+ weeks post-trough, so an immediate breakout above pre-selloff levels indicates this is not that pattern and the bottom-call is wrong

falsification_conditions.condition: VIX closes below 14.00 for 3 consecutive trading days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A BLOWOFF SCORE of 40 implies residual fear/forced selling pressure; sustained VIX compression below 14 would confirm fear has fully dissipated, invalidating the 'hold' signal that expects at least one more washout or consolidation leg

falsification_conditions.condition: 10Y Treasury yield drops below 3.80% while S&P 500 simultaneously trades above 5,500
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: This would signal a 'bad news is good news' Fed pivot trade, indicating markets have shifted to pricing aggressive rate cuts due to recession fear rather than the soft-landing bottom pattern; the macro engine's pattern match requires yields and equities to move in tandem (yields up, stocks recovering) to validate the call

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
